title: Bora Employer Pipeline Application Question
description: Immutable/append-oriented source-truth record of one question actually presented on an application route (may diverge from, or be absent from, the public job description). This record must never be mutated after capture; re-evaluation against changed Evidence produces a new ApplicationQuestionEvaluation, never a change to this record.

application_question_id.description: Permanent unique identifier for this application question.

application_attempt_id.description: ApplicationAttempt this question was captured from.

question_text.description: Exact or faithfully captured source text of the question as presented by the employer/platform.

question_type.description: Minimal V1 type vocabulary. UNSUPPORTED is used for any question shape V1 does not attempt to model; such questions must fail safely to manual review rather than being forced into a supported type.

required.description: Whether the application route marked this question as required.

captured_at.description: Date this question's text was captured.

clause_text.description: Faithfully captured sub-requirement text extracted from question_text.

mapped_requirement_id.description: An existing JD Requirement_ID this clause corresponds to, or null when the application route introduced this clause independently of the public job description. A fake JD Requirement must never be created merely to populate this field.

clauses.description: Minimal decomposition of question_text into evaluable sub-requirements. Empty array when the question is not a compound requirement (e.g. free-text or a single atomic fact).

logic_expression.description: Recursive boolean-combination structure over clause_id leaves. Null when the question has zero or one clause (no compound logic to represent).

answer_policy.description: SAFE_REUSABLE: answer may be reused only where repository evidence and existing policy allow. REVIEW: requires human review before use. ALWAYS_HUMAN: machine must not decide/enter the final answer (work authorization, future sponsorship, visa/immigration, legal attestations, criminal/background attestations, EEO/demographic questions, and similarly consequential categories).

screening_materiality.description: How materially the truthful answer affects OUR OWN application evaluation. This is not a prediction of hidden employer/ATS behavior.

filter_risk.description: Conservative candidate-observable filter-risk signal only. Default is UNKNOWN. POTENTIAL_KNOCKOUT requires a stronger observable signal than merely 'question is required' and must never be escalated to an assertion of actual employer/ATS auto-reject configuration, which this schema deliberately does not represent.

notes.description: Optional clarifications or provenance notes. Null when no note is needed.

n.description: Required positive integer threshold when op is AT_LEAST_N; null otherwise.

terms.description: Each term is either a clause_id (string leaf) or a nested logic_expression.
